correctness.rationale: For Rule 18, one-step output 1 is generated exactly by neighborhoods 001 or 100. In mixed inputs every long zero run produces two output ones and determines one of two cyclic alternating matchings of positive sites; intervening corridors between long-zero runs must start/end with input 1 and avoid adjacent zeros, counted by Fibonacci F_t. This proves the exact two-matching product-sum formula; odd-weight outputs have no preimages. The zero-output fiber counts cyclic no-adjacent-zero inputs plus all zero: Lucas_n+1. A two-one output at cyclic distance d has F_{d-1}+F_{n-d-1}, sharply maximal at d=1 or n-1 for n>=7. For >=4 output ones, each matching contributes at most F_{n-3r+1}, so total <=2F_{n-5}<F_{n-2}. Independent direct full preimage enumeration for bounded rings confirms zero maximum and exactly n adjacent-pair runners-up; the inequalities supply the infinite proof.
